init.description:
📁 Workflow:
1. In webapp: click '⬇️ Save as file'
2. Open file with a text editor (Notepad, TextEdit, etc.)
3. Copy content (Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C)
4. Paste here (Ctrl+V)

⚙️ Hardware type: determines the maximum transition time for your lights
